component.name: AppDeb
component.summary: Install and manage Flatpak, AppImage, .deb and .tar.gz applications

description.p: AppDeb is a full-control application manager for Debian-based Linux desktops. It installs and removes Flatpak applications, AppImages, local .deb packages and portable .tar.gz applications from a single window.

Each installed application gets a details page with its icon, version, size, scope, executable, desktop entry, file locations, live CPU and memory usage, Flatpak permissions, and an autostart switch. AppDeb also repairs desktop entries that show a generic icon in the dock by setting the window class association, renaming menu entries, and creating desktop shortcuts.
Added a step-by-step user guide for beginners, published to the project wiki and readable from the repository, with a link checker in CI.
English is selectable again in the language list, and file-type routing for "Open with AppDeb" now shares one code path with a registration check.
Snap channel switching, snap refresh and update hold, and apt package holds added to the application parameters.

Homebrew formula and Snap install support, a package manager dashboard, store details with screenshots, package-manager switching for the same app, editable desktop parameters, and the correct window/desktop icon association.
First release: Flatpak, AppImage, .deb and .tar.gz management, desktop entry doctor, CLI.
